title: Field Repair
notes: - **Id:** `field_repair`. **Save as:** `art/icons/perks/field-repair.png`. **Mode:** Wick icon. **Shows:** the perk card.
paint: The icon shows: Wick crouched beside a plain long invented weapon laid across his knee, a long jawed spanner set to the jammed action, one hand bracing the stock, the open breech showing a single bent part half out. A short curl of motion on the spanner shows it turning. The spanner on the weapon is what to read at 32 px. Avoid: a toolbox full of tools, a real firearm model, a wrench inside a gear cog, sparks.
adaptation: Image service rejected the original. Preserve the spanner, angled knee brace, jammed fitting and abstract repair cue using an invented non-weapon powered field instrument.
renderPaint: Wick the small ceramic automaton crouches with a long invented field instrument resting across his knee. A chunky jawed spanner turns a loose external hex collar on the instrument, while his other mitten braces its padded back end. One bent bracket is visible beside the tool and a small curve describes the turn. The instrument is a fantasy measuring tool with a blunt rounded cap, compact gauge and simple steady silhouette. At 32 px read Wick turning a spanner on a field instrument. No firearms, projectiles, effects, letters or extra tools.
label: Field Repair
prompt:
Draw one icon in pure white flat ink (#FFFFFF) on a fully transparent background, in exactly the style of the attached reference icons: Wick, the small figure of the trait and perk icons with the ceramic pixel-screen head, capelet and lantern heart, in bold flat white shapes, a confident inked silhouette with a few interior cuts, the same line weight. No outline in another colour, no shading, no gradient, no texture, no glow, no colour and no grey. Wick is the only full solid figure; anyone else is a partial (a hand, a shoulder, a silhouette cut by the frame); a Figment is a hollow figure in one bold white contour with two or three parallel hatch strokes inside. One action, centred, with clear space around it, square, 1024 x 1024 PNG with transparency. It must read at 32 px in a row and at 44 px on a chip: silhouette first, two or three interior cuts at most. No text, no letters, no numbers, no border, no frame. Invented shapes only: nothing recognisable from real-world works, brands or insignia. The icon shows:
Wick the small ceramic automaton crouches with a long invented field instrument resting across his knee. A chunky jawed spanner turns a loose external hex collar on the instrument, while his other mitten braces its padded back end. One bent bracket is visible beside the tool and a small curve describes the turn. The instrument is a fantasy measuring tool with a blunt rounded cap, compact gauge and simple steady silhouette. At 32 px read Wick turning a spanner on a field instrument. No firearms, projectiles, effects, letters or extra tools.
Wick always has the exact approved oversized rounded ceramic screen head, transparent face recess with white pixel expression, ear discs, offset shell fittings, short asymmetric capelet, lantern-heart inset, chunky mitten hands and cuffed boots. The silhouette of the head ends at the smooth ceramic shell. There is NO flame, tuft, plume, candle or object attached to or above his head. Resolve any stale flame wording through the angle or pixel expression. Omit default floating cup and reference arrows.
 
All dark voids are physically transparent alpha cutouts, never solid black or gray. Clear border, stable negative space at game size, pure white flat ink.
